# Cloud GTM vendors: Tackle, Clazar, Suger, WorkSpan

Built 2026-09-26. All VENDOR sources. These four sit on thousands of listings and co-sell transactions,
so their content carries operational detail the hyperscalers do not publish. Their marketing also
lags program changes: all four had 2026 pages still teaching retired rules or names. Official pages
win every conflict. Full extraction, conflicts and inventories are in the four per-vendor files.

| File | Read it for |
|---|---|
| `tackle-intelligence.md` | Survey data (State of Cloud GTM 2025, true sample 83), Cloud GTM XP 2026 talks by AWS, Microsoft and Google leaders, rep-led co-sell patterns (Datadog, CrowdStrike, Honeycomb) |
| `clazar-intelligence.md` | Help-center rule detail, AWS vendor-routed credits, Microsoft deal registration checks, Clazar MCP server, HubSpot sync |
| `suger-intelligence.md` | Highest-volume rule and edge-case library, AWS Opportunity Quality Score data, private offer failure modes, AWS PDM webinar (August 2026) |
| `workspan-intelligence.md` | AWS deadline notices (S3 sync, console migration), Microsoft field-comp quotes, AWS rejection-message checklist, HubSpot two-way referral sync, pricing benchmarks |

**How Alex recommends a tool:** CRM first (HubSpot customers: shortlist Clazar, Suger and WorkSpan and
demo the exact HubSpot flow; Tackle only if AWS-only and Salesforce is coming), then clouds needed in
12 months, then whether the platform surfaces AWS Opportunity Quality Score and Microsoft deal
registration checks, then pricing model, then ownership stability. Forecastable does not resell or
endorse any of them; label every recommendation as ours and every claim as VENDOR.

## 2. The twelve findings that change advice

1. **Most ISVs get little revenue from marketplace.** Tackle's 2025 survey median is 0 to 10% of revenue through marketplace; the 20% to 32% headline is a mean. 73% value commit access; 75% see little lead-gen benefit. Top blocker: engaging field sellers (55%).
2. **Field activation is the lever.** WorkSpan customer data (method unpublished): win rates 22% to 47% when the cloud rep is activated. Datadog's co-sell button on every account produced more partner-originated than AWS-originated deals (Tackle XP 2026).
3. **Hyperscaler sellers are paid on marketplace.** Microsoft CVP Nina Harding: "our field is paid off of Marketplace transactions" (April 2026). AWS: one ISV reported reps retired "42% of our deal" (2025). No hyperscaler publishes a rate.
4. **AWS Opportunity Quality Score is lost on record quality.** Suger data: lowest bucket all scored 0, many with template text; best 50 to 75. An AWS PDM said scoring follows a MEDDPICC-like model and rewards a specific ask. Tackle: triage, keep most deals partner-led.
5. **AWS deadlines not on AWS pages:** S3 CRM sync ends 2026-09-30 (WorkSpan notice); console migration final date 2026-09-30 per AWS emails. Act as if true.
6. **AWS vendor-routed credits exist:** List & Sell and CRM-connect credits ($10K each) and a possible $5K for 10+ opportunities updated via the Partner Central MCP by 2026-12-01 (Clazar). Unpublished; verify with the PDM.
7. **The cheapest first marketplace deal is a migration at renewal,** 1.5% fee on all three clouds when flagged correctly (Clazar; AWS fee page confirms the renewal rate).
8. **Microsoft channel choice is "who pays you".** REO: reseller pays the ISV off-Marketplace, no deal visibility. MPO: Microsoft pays, deal visible (Suger).
9. **Private offer failures are predictable** (Suger): AWS expiry, locked account IDs, "active contract" error, buyer permissions, card limits; Google free-trial billing accounts and self-serve limits.
10. **AWS ACE data now routes partners** (Solution Matching Engine, per an AWS PDM) and PRM ends the old "30% of TCV counts as consumption" assumption. Unofficial, directionally important.
11. **Google previews on vendor stages:** deal registration redesign, MCCP variable credits, distributor private offer pilot (Tackle XP 2026). Not yet official.
12. **Vendor pages go stale fast.** Google 50% commit cap (official 25%), "Partner Advantage", Microsoft ISV Success and Marketplace Rewards rebates, MPO "US/UK only". Eva never quotes a vendor rule without checking the cloud file.

## 3. Registry and refresh

The four vendors are Tier 1 in each cloud registry and the cross-cloud registry. Each per-vendor file
ends with the people, channels and discovery queries to walk monthly. Refresh order each month:
official Tier 0 feeds first, then these vendors, so vendor claims are checked against what is already
known.
